// NOTE: This is an example configuration file showing all available options with detailed comments
// USAGE: Copy sections to appsettings.Development.json and fill in your actual values
// STRUCTURE: This file demonstrates the NEW multi-provider configuration structure (recommended)

Agent.// SystemPrompt: The system prompt sent to the LLM at the start of every conversation
Agent.SystemPrompt: You are a helpful AI assistant with expertise in software development.
Agent.// ContextWindowSize: Maximum number of messages to keep in LLM context (older messages are truncated but remain visible in UI)

LLM.// ActiveProvider: The config name of the currently active provider (must match a key in Providers)
LLM.// DefaultParameters: Default parameters inherited by all providers (can be overridden per-provider)

DefaultParameters.// Temperature: Controls randomness (0.0 = deterministic, 2.0 = very random). Recommended: 0.7
DefaultParameters.// MaxTokens: Maximum tokens in LLM response. Recommended: 4096
DefaultParameters.// UseRest: Use REST API instead of streaming (false = streaming, true = REST). Default: false (streaming)

LLM.// Providers: Dictionary of provider configurations. You can define multiple providers and switch between them via UI.

ExtendedThinking.// Enabled: Enable extended thinking to see Claude's internal reasoning
ExtendedThinking.// BudgetTokens: Max tokens for reasoning (min: 1024, must be < MaxTokens)

claude-thinking.// ParameterOverrides: Override default parameters for this provider

Parameters.// AuthenticationMode: Use DefaultAzureCredential for OAuth/Microsoft Entra ID (no API key needed)
// Automatically discovers credentials from: environment variables, managed identity, az CLI, Visual Studio, etc.
Parameters.// TenantId: Optional: Specify Azure AD tenant ID for multi-tenant scenarios

Parameters.// AuthenticationMode: Use InteractiveBrowserCredential for interactive login (opens browser popup)
// Best for desktop GUI applications with interactive user login
Parameters.// TenantId: Optional: Specify Azure AD tenant ID

Parameters.// IsReasoningModel: REQUIRED for o1/o3/GPT-5 models. Uses max_completion_tokens instead of max_tokens.

azure-o3-mini.// ParameterOverrides: Reasoning models do NOT support Temperature/TopP - override to null

Parameters.// Example: Use this for OpenAI-compatible endpoints that only support REST API

custom-rest-provider.// ParameterOverrides: Override UseRest to true for REST-only providers
